_meta.notes: Summary Page header: Page 2 of 4, WINDER, 1/31/07. Column B values verified on a 300dpi crop ('153268.30' and '155076.55'; this hand writes 6 like a lower-case b). Line 7 is NEGATIVE and written '-808.81' - transcribed verbatim. Column A arithmetic consistent (13696.74 + 6600 = 20296.74; 20296.74 - 21105.55 = -808.81). NEITHER amendment box is checked.

contributions.detail: delta +270.00 and the discrepancy is INSIDE THE FILER'S OWN PAGE, not in the transcription. The 10 named contribution rows as printed are 50, 30, 150, 150, 40, 300, 300, 250, 5000, 300, which sum to 6,570.00 - but the line immediately beneath them prints 'Total Contributions $6,300.00'. Adding the printed In-Kind row ($300, Wasatch Brew Pub) the page prints 'Total Contributions & In-Kind Donations $6,600', which is the Summary Page line 1 figure in the chunk; the rows as printed give 6,870.00. EVERY amount was re-read in 400 dpi column crops and read identically, so the 270.00 is the filer's arithmetic. Nothing was adjusted; both figures are retained.

expenditures.detail: exact (21,105.55 = 21,105.55); the 36 expenditure rows sum to the printed 'Total Expenditure $20,805.55' and adding the printed In-Kind row ($300) gives the printed 'Total Expenditure & In-Kind $21,105.55' = Summary Page line 2

itemized.page_subtotal_gates: Neither attachment prints a per-page SUBTOTAL (the filer replaced the county grid with her own typed schedules). p4 gates EXACTLY: 36 rows = 20,805.55 = printed 'Total Expenditure', +300 in-kind = 21,105.55 = printed grand total. p3 DOES NOT GATE: 10 rows = 6,570.00 vs printed 'Total Contributions' 6,300.00 (delta 270.00); with the in-kind row 6,870.00 vs printed 6,600.
itemized.escalation_note: p3 required a rotation test (+90 CCW is upright; -90 came out inverted) and then, when the page failed to gate, the whole Amount column plus the Name/Date columns were re-read in 400 dpi crops. All ten amounts and all ten names/dates read identically to the first pass, so the 270.00 gap is the filer's own subtotal, not a misread digit.
itemized.notes: A 4-page filing: p1 cover, p2 Summary Page, p3 Schedule A (typed attachment, rotated 90 deg in the PDF), p4 Schedule B (typed attachment, portrait). Filer James M. Winder, Sheriff; 2006 year-end. THE CONTRIBUTIONS PAGE DOES NOT ADD UP TO ITS OWN TOTAL: the ten printed amounts sum to 6,570.00 against a printed 'Total Contributions' of 6,300.00. Verified at 400 dpi; retained verbatim, never reconciled. PRIVACY: nothing to record - the Address column is printed but empty on every row, so donor_city and donor_state are blank. Each schedule carries its In-Kind row BELOW its main total, so the printed grand totals are 'contributions + in-kind' and 'expenditures + in-kind'; both in-kind rows are the same $300 Wasatch Brew Pub food/beverage donation appearing on both sides. One row is the CANDIDATE'S OWN LOAN, labelled '(Personal Loan)' in the name cell ($5,000) and flagged needs_review. Three Schedule B rows are refunds OUT to contributors ($2,000 each to Michael & Sharon Midgley, Clark Evans and Suan Lynn). One Schedule B row has a blank Purpose and reads 'Check Card Withdrawl' [sic] $1,112.25 - the only amount on the page printed without a dollar sign. 'Itemized Contribtuions', 'Authroize.net', 'Suan Lynn' and 'Wasatch Brew Pub' are all as printed.
